programmes.d: Ther are million ways to destroy a car: Crashes, flips and jumps. We show the highlights of this seasons car stunts.
This show brings you the best mix of national and international powersports from around the world.
Monster Jam is an American monster truck series where drivers have to perform stunts and race against each other.
The "Australian Drag Racing Championship" is a regional motorsport series for top fuel dragsters that exceed speeds of roughly 300 mp/h in under 5 seconds.
The Icelandic Formula Off-Road is one of the most extreme racing series in the world and demands everything from the teams and their specially built vehicles.

The 2025 European Motocross Championship is the 37th European Motocross Championship season since it was revived in 1988. It includes 16 events and 6 different classes. It will start in Spain on 16 March and will end in Turkey on 7 September.
The FIM QuadCross World Championship (formerly EMX Quad European Championship) is the premier international competition for quad bike motocross.
The "AWDC" is a british offorad event where drivers have to tackle tight and twisty roads filled with mud und gravel.

Extreme Winter Test: We push the Mercedes G 580 EQ to its limits on the snowy Timmelsjoch High Alpine Road and uncover all the pros and cons of the new electric drivetrain. Does the electric G still feel like a true G-Class? And we get an exclusive drive in the new, still camouflaged CLA.
We visited a Hot Rod Hanger near Vienna with the largest private Mopa Muscle car collection in Europe. The entire collection has been built up by over the last 30 years by a true artist: Knud Tiroch.

Stuntman Dominik Kowalski is an expert for falls, drops and body stunts. But today is different: he is supposed to drive the stunt car! The job: a flip through a cola truck! This is not for the weak-minded! Will Nick fail or is he the right man for this stunt.

Going Pro follows the journey of gentlemen drivers and talented young drivers as they take the crucial step from karting or into professional motorsport. With everything on the line, these stars face intense pressure, life-changing decisions and the harsh realities of climbing the racing ladder.

Gearing Up shows the world's most unique motorsport events covering cars, bikes and everything else.

Brands from the Far East are turning up the pressure: Kia is expanding its lineup with the compact EV2. We find out what it has to offer against its bigger siblings and the competition. And Geely, China's second-largest car manufacturer, is now aiming to establish a foothold in Europe.

BMW X5M, Audi Q7, Mercedes GLS and Porsche Cayenne turbo are the strongest and fastest SUVs of the world. Sports utility vehicles 'made in Germany'are the embodiment of technical perfection, superior performance and unique comfort.

The days of family minivans are over! Today, it’s SUVs that are expected to provide room for seven passengers plus luggage. At Volkswagen, the Tayron takes over from the Touran. With seemingly endless space and premium-class features, it’s becoming a top choice for families.

It doesn't get boring! Manufacturers of SUVs and off-road vehicles have never offered such a variety of powertrains. From a roaring V8 to quiet electric hum: The new Porsche Cayenne offers the right concept for every fan.

The Nitrolympx is the biggest international drag race event in Europe. Every year 30,000 - 35,000 visitors attend the festival to watch a highly explosive mix of action, show and extreme acceleration. About 300-350 drivers take part in any of the classes that the Nitrolympx has to offer.
The Stunt Heroes bring a quad bike to its limits. With a so-called stamp and a pressure of 100 bar the quad bike will learn to fly.

Australian Circuit Boat Racing offers high-speed thrills on the water, where precision and speed decide intense races on demanding courses. Spectacular competitions captivate motorsport fans across Australia.

The "F1H20 World Powerboat Championship" is the worlds' fastest boat racing championship with speeds up to 250 kp/h.
Caution, danger of splashing! Since 1992, the Aquabike World Championship has been the most important racing series in the sport of jet skiing and one of the fastest competitions in water sports.

The Land Rover Defender makes the hearts of offraod fans leap since over 70 years. Can the modern Landy follow in the footsteps of the old icon? And: How does offroad driving work exactly? We let an offroad beginner onto rough grounds.
Today, the first race at the new Red Bull Ring takes place. Yes, not only is it a super day but there are some crazy cars here at the Histocup.

Revisiting the past to portray the classic and veteran cars of decades gone by, meeting the personalities who wrote automotive history, sending very old cars running round very fast circuits.
The Belcar Endurance Championship is the top-tier national endurance racing championship in Belgium. The series is sanctioned by the Royal Automobile Club of Belgium and run by Circuit Zolder.

1952. Start of the legendary 24 hour endurance race at Le Mans. A race steeped in history. The Mercedes returns to the famous circuit after 22 years. And Ferrari uses factory works team cars for the first time.
The Volkswagen Group is the second biggest car company in the world. It all starts in 1936 with one car: the Volkswagen Beetle.
The legendary Pikes Peak International Hillclimb returns to the 156-turn, 12.42-mile mountain course known as "The Race to the Clouds".
Portrait of Ferruccio Lamborghini, who originally built tractors, but then moved on to found one of the most famous sports car factories in the world.
Talking of motorsport without speaking of France is impossible.

All-Wheel drive is not just for off-road adventures. The new Mercedes E-Class T-Model sends its power to all four wheels to ensure abnormal acceleration and the best dynamic handling in bends. Paired with the output of 333 hp, the AMG version becomes a powerful estate wagon.
Today we are at a special event at the Hockenheim Ring in Germany. Because, for over 20 years, the best tuners and drifters in Europe have come here to take part in the 'Tuner Grand Prix'. Enjoy.
